claims.limitations: Finite reproduction using one numerical backend. It is far below the published record and cannot establish the universal statement RH.
claims.statement: FLINT/Arb isolated 10,000 ordered critical-line Hardy-Z roots, and Turing counts account for every nontrivial zeta zero below the final separator T approximately 9878.2187131956.

claims.limitations: Lagarias's theorem quantifies over every positive integer. A positive finite prefix cannot prove RH.
claims.statement: The Lagarias inequality is certified for every integer 1 <= n <= 1,000,000, with equality only at n=1.

claims.limitations: One positive finite compression cannot prove RH or exclude negative directions elsewhere. The negative omission control is deliberately corrupted and has no implication for RH.
claims.statement: The complete finite Weil matrix A=P-R-S for c=5/2 and modes -4 through 4 is positive definite by nine interval LDL^T pivots; deleting its sole p^r=2 term produces a certified negative mutation control.

claims.limitations: This certifies one finite 256-to-512 contraction using one FLINT/Arb backend. It gives no N=512 lower bound and does not establish the uniform k>=9 recurrence required for the Nyman limit and RH.
claims.statement: A direct exact-dyadic primal witness and a fresh replay of the certified N=256 lower endpoint prove d_512^2 < (449/500)d_256^2, so the normalized optimal block gain is greater than 51/500.

claims.limitations: This rejects one explicit eight-dimensional trial space at the single 256-to-512 extension using one FLINT/Arb backend. It does not reject other trial spaces, establish the uniform k>=9 recurrence, or prove or disprove RH.
claims.statement: For the frozen eight-column arithmetic trial space at the N=256 to N=512 extension, fixed-order interval LDL^T proves F_V > (9/10)U_256 and therefore its optimal captured gain Gamma(V) is strictly less than d_256^2/10.

claims.limitations: This exact finite audit does not prove the log(2) integral identity or the infinite divergence theorem, which remain an external human-auditable bridge in the cited 2005 preprint. The theorem rejects only the first one-coefficient-at-a-time Vasyunin correction, not all Vasyunin or Nyman constructions, and does not prove or disprove RH.

scope.arithmetic: exact integers and reduced rational multipliers

claims.statement: For every 1 <= n <= 4096, the first Vasyunin greedy recurrence matches the two-adic Mobius closed formula, preserves exact interval interpolation, and has the recorded exact rational L1 and squared-L2 increment multipliers; at all twelve nontrivial powers of two those multipliers are 1/2 and n/4.

claims.limitations: No finite set of positive compressions controls every Fourier mode and a cofinal unbounded family of cutoffs; the universal positivity theorem remains missing.
claims.statement: Finite-prime Weil quadratic forms are the primary candidate-witness and proof-bridge research track.
